subject: Request: shift CIO window + VP presence (finalize slot)
messages:
From: Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@edgewave.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Need to move CIO slot + confirm VP presence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for lining up next week’s demo. Our CIO (Priya) has a conflict and asked whether we can move the 11/30 3:00pm ET slot to earlier in the day — ideally between 10:00–11:30am ET.

Also, our VP of Engineering (Marco) wants to attend alongside the CIO; can you confirm Redwood can have a VP- or CTO-level sponsor in the room? That’s a hard ask for procurement to greenlight the next steps.

If moving it is difficult, we can also accept the original slot if you can guarantee exec-level coverage (even if remote).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can lock calendars.

Best,
Ankit
Director, Platform Engineering
EdgeWave, Inc.

--
Attachment: current-infra-overview.pdf (referenced)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Need to move CIO slot + confirm VP presence

Thanks Ankit — I hear you. We can absolutely prioritize exec coverage. Two quick notes and options: 

1) Availability: We can shift the meeting to 11/30 at either 10:30am ET or 11:15am ET (both 45-minute blocks). The earlier 10:30am option is preferable for our VP/CTO calendars.

2) Execs: Our CTO-sponsor (Rishi) is the best fit for the technical exec lane. I’m looping in Stephanie to confirm Rishi’s schedule and whether we should do a 30-minute pre-brief/dry-run with internal attendees.

3) Next steps: If either window works, I’ll update the invite and attach the latest demo deck + mutual action plan for your procurement review.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf, edgewave-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Proposed calendar text for quick copy: 
"""EdgeWave — Redwood Inference platform demo (CIO/VP attendance)
Duration: 45 min
Agenda: 1) Exec intro (10 min) 2) 25 min focused demo 3) Q&A and follow-ups
"""

If you send a preferred time I’ll lock it in.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0191

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@edgewave.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Need to move CIO slot + confirm VP presence

Looping in Rishi — Rishi, can you confirm you can cover the 10:30am or 11:15am ET window on 11/30? We’d like to do a 30-min dry run 30 minutes before the demo (so either 10:00am or 10:45am ET).

Rishi — priority asks from EdgeWave: 
- CIO + VP will attend (senior execs) — keep the top-level architecture and ROI slides to the front.
- Expect a deep question on multi-tenant isolation and audit logs (SOC 2) — bring the compliance slide and a quick note on Private/VPC options.
- Procurement will want the mutual action plan and pricing band; both are attached.

I attached an internal dry-run runbook with roles (who says what), timing, and sample Q&A. If you’re unavailable we need to escalate to VP backup (Marcus or Naomi) within the hour so we can confirm with the customer.

Attachments: exec-dryrun-runbook.docx

-steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@edgewave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Need to move CIO slot + confirm VP presence

Thanks all — I can take the 10:30am ET slot on 11/30 and will join the 10:00am ET dry run. Planning notes: I’ll lead the exec intro (10 min), cover architecture + security (12 min), then hand back to Tessa for feature demo.

Ankit — 10:30am ET works on our side. I’ll make sure the compliance slide with retention/audit examples is pinned near the top and we’ll prepare a 2-slide appendix for procurement. If you’d like a whiteboard walkthrough on the multi-tenant isolation model, put that in the agenda and we’ll leave 10 minutes for it.

See you Tuesday — sending a calendar update now with the updated times and the attached runbook + deck.

Rishi Malhotra
CTO (acting demo sponsor) | Redwood Inference
